description: Read a file from a sandbox. Returns UTF-8 text by default, or base64 when encoding is set to base64 (use it for binary files). Files larger than 1 MiB are rejected — read a slice with sandbox_exec instead.

path.description: Absolute path inside the sandbox, e.g. "/app/main.py".

name: sandbox_files_read
title: Read a file from a sandbox
